environment.description: Go binary compiled to a Lambda-compatible bootstrap binary, deployed as an AWS Lambda function with a Function URL. The Function URL resource policy has AuthType set to AWS_IAM (not NONE). The Lambda function's resource-based policy does NOT include a lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission with principal '*' or any open condition. The function URL configuration was created via CreateFunctionUrlConfig with AuthType=AWS_IAM. Callers must present valid SigV4-signed requests with credentials from an IAM principal that has been explicitly granted lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission on this function's ARN. Unsigned HTTP requests receive a 403 Forbidden response at the Lambda invoke layer before the function code executes. Note: the code itself has no auth checks, and the /tmp storage is ephemeral Lambda scratch space (512MB, cleared between cold starts). An AWS Organizations SCP on the account restricts lambda:AddPermission to deny any Statement that sets Principal to '*' on FunctionUrl resources, preventing accidental public access grants.

config.scp_constraint: Deny lambda:AddPermission where Principal=* on FunctionUrl resources
config.networking: Function URL endpoint (no ALB, no API Gateway)
config.iam_boundary: Permission boundary on all roles prevents lambda:UpdateFunctionUrlConfig with AuthType=NONE
